card.name: Linking words before a described thing
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (that, in, by, the, a comma, a quote mark) right after a noun, where a descriptive phrase or method comes next. Seen in definitions, mixing steps and lists of equipment.

modes.label: Relative or linking word after a noun
modes.description: A word such as that or in follows a noun and starts a description of it.
modes.example: the colorless fluid<< that>> surrounds the brain and spinal cord.

modes.label: By before a mixing method
modes.description: The word by follows Mix in preparation directions, before gentle inversion.

modes.label: Comma in a list of equipment
modes.description: A comma inside a list of required items.
modes.example: including cardiac monitoring equipment<<,>> intracardiac pacing facilities, a

card.writes: It promotes words meaning constantly or constant and suppresses words starting with ter, so it nudges toward continuous or constant wording.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that lead into a description, such as how something is done or what surrounds something.
